annotations.title: The Gospel, in the house's words

description: Return The Living Bread's own summary of the Christian gospel, the same text as its /the-gospel and /who-is-jesus pages: four short steps (God's love, separation by sin, Jesus' death and resurrection, new life received by faith), each with its key verse read verbatim from the stored KJV, a statement of who Jesus is, and links to respond. Use for "what is the gospel", "how do I become a Christian", "is Jesus God". For one doctrine in depth (grace, the Trinity) use belief; for someone from another religion use christianity_and_other_faiths; for joining the app use begin. Fixed content, no parameters; the wording is the house's, labelled in content_layers. Access: no sign-in; shared limit of 300 requests a minute per IP.
name: the_gospel
